== 13 months equals a year? ==

If you do the math, 13X28 = 336, more than a month short of 365. What am I missing?[[User:Pedantic|Pedantic]] 13:45, May 16, 2012 (UTC)

:12X28=336. 13X28=364. Add [[Sunday]] and you get 365. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 15:18, May 16, 2012 (UTC)
